[arXiv:1809.10486](https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.10486)，2018；本次读的是该题名的 arXiv 文本，不将其等同于2021 Nature Methods最终文或 nnU-Net v2的完整配方。

26: def get_dataloader(cfg: yacs.config.CfgNode, mode: str):
27:     """
28:     Create the dataset and pytorch data loader.
29: 
30:     Parameters
31:     ----------
32:     cfg : yacs.config.CfgNode
33:         Configuration node.
34:     mode : str
35:         Loading data for train, val and test mode.
36: 
37:     Returns
38:     -------
39:     torch.utils.data.DataLoader
40:         Dataloader with given configs and mode.
41:     """
42:     assert mode in ["train", "val"], f"dataloader mode is incorrect {mode}"
43: 
44:     padding_size = cfg.DATA.PADDED_SIZE
45: 
46:     if mode == "train":
47: 
48:         if "None" in cfg.DATA.AUG:
49:             tfs = [ZeroPad2D((padding_size, padding_size)), ToTensor()]
50:             # old transform
51:             if "Gaussian" in cfg.DATA.AUG:
52:                 tfs.append(AddGaussianNoise(mean=0, std=0.1))
53: 
54:             data_path = cfg.DATA.PATH_HDF5_TRAIN
55:             shuffle = True
56: 
57:             logger.info(
58:                 f"Loading {mode.capitalize()} data ... from {data_path}. Using standard Aug"
59:             )
60: 
61:             dataset = dset.MultiScaleDatasetVal(data_path, cfg, transforms.Compose(tfs))
62:         else:
63: 
64:             import torchio as tio
65:             # Elastic
66:             elastic = tio.RandomElasticDeformation(
67:                 num_control_points=7,
68:                 max_displacement=(20, 20, 0),
69:                 locked_borders=2,
70:                 image_interpolation="linear",
71:                 include=["img", "label", "weight"],
72:             )
73:             # Scales
74:             scaling = tio.RandomAffine(
75:                 scales=(0.8, 1.15),
76:                 degrees=0,
77:                 translation=(0, 0, 0),
78:                 isotropic=True,  # If True, scaling factor along all dimensions is the same
79:                 center="image",
80:                 default_pad_value="minimum",
81:                 image_interpolation="linear",
82:                 include=["img", "label", "weight"],
83:             )
84: 
85:             # Rotation
86:             rot = tio.RandomAffine(
87:                 scales=(1.0, 1.0),
88:                 degrees=10,
89:                 translation=(0, 0, 0),
90:                 isotropic=True,  # If True, scaling factor along all dimensions is the same
91:                 center="image",
92:                 default_pad_value="minimum",
93:                 image_interpolation="linear",
94:                 include=["img", "label", "weight"],
95:             )
96: 
97:             # Translation
98:             tl = tio.RandomAffine(
99:                 scales=(1.0, 1.0),
100:                 degrees=0,
101:                 translation=(15.0, 15.0, 0),
102:                 isotropic=True,  # If True, scaling factor along all dimensions is the same
103:                 center="image",
104:                 default_pad_value="minimum",
105:                 image_interpolation="linear",
106:                 include=["img", "label", "weight"],
107:             )
108: 
109:             # Random Anisotropy (Downsample image along an axis, then upsample back to initial space
110:             ra = tio.transforms.RandomAnisotropy(
111:                 axes=(0, 1),
112:                 downsampling=(1.1, 1.5),
113:                 image_interpolation="linear",
114:                 include=["img"],
115:             )
116: 
117:             # Bias Field
118:             bias_field = tio.transforms.RandomBiasField(
119:                 coefficients=0.5, order=3, include=["img"]
120:             )
121: 
122:             # Gamma
123:             random_gamma = tio.transforms.RandomGamma(
124:                 log_gamma=(-0.1, 0.1), include=["img"]
125:             )
126: 
127:             #
128: 
129:             all_augs = {
130:                 "Elastic": elastic,
131:                 "Scaling": scaling,
132:                 "Rotation": rot,
133:                 "Translation": tl,
134:                 "RAnisotropy": ra,
135:                 "BiasField": bias_field,
136:                 "RGamma": random_gamma,
137:             }
138: 
139:             all_tfs = {all_augs[aug]: 0.8 for aug in cfg.DATA.AUG if aug != "Gaussian"}
140:             gaussian_noise = True if "Gaussian" in cfg.DATA.AUG else False
141: 
142:             transform = tio.Compose(
143:                 [tio.Compose(all_tfs, p=0.8)], include=["img", "label", "weight"]
144:             )
145: 
146:             data_path = cfg.DATA.PATH_HDF5_TRAIN
147:             shuffle = True
148: 
149:             logger.info(
150:                 f"Loading {mode.capitalize()} data ... from {data_path}. Using torchio Aug"
151:             )
152: 
153:             dataset = dset.MultiScaleDataset(data_path, cfg, gaussian_noise, transform)
154: 
155:     elif mode == "val":
156:         data_path = cfg.DATA.PATH_HDF5_VAL
157:         shuffle = False
158:         transform = transforms.Compose(
159:             [
160:                 ZeroPad2D((padding_size, padding_size)),
161:                 ToTensor(),
162:             ]
163:         )
164: 
165:         logger.info(f"Loading {mode.capitalize()} data ... from {data_path}")
166: 
167:         dataset = dset.MultiScaleDatasetVal(data_path, cfg, transform)
168: 
169:     dataloader = DataLoader(
170:         dataset,
171:         batch_size=cfg.TRAIN.BATCH_SIZE,
172:         num_workers=cfg.TRAIN.NUM_WORKERS,
173:         shuffle=shuffle,
174:         pin_memory=True,
175:     )
176:     return dataloader
